description: Expandable content panel container that manages child TmAccordionItem components, supporting single or multiple simultaneous expansion. The expansion state can be group-controlled through ExpandedKeys (@bind-ExpandedKeys) keyed by the items' Key parameter — the foundation for URL-synced accordions.

parameters.name: Multiple
parameters.description: Allow multiple items open at once.

parameters.name: ExpandedKeys
parameters.description: Group control of the expansion state by item key (@bind-ExpandedKeys). While non-null, every keyed item is owned by this parameter (its own IsExpanded is ignored); items without a key stay self-managed. Keys compare ordinally (case-sensitive) and duplicate Keys share one state. Single mode keeps at most one RENDERED item expanded — a seed with several keys keeps the first item in registration order — while keys without a matching item survive every snapshot untouched at its end.

parameters.name: ExpandedKeysChanged
parameters.description: Raised once per user toggle with the new immutable key snapshot (registration order — DOM order for a static item list; an item inserted conditionally later is appended). A host that does not adopt the snapshot rejects the toggle.

parameters.name: OnItemToggled
parameters.description: Raised for every user-driven expansion change — the clicked item and, in single mode, each sibling closed implicitly (close notifications come first). Carries Key (null for keyless items), Expanded and the registration Index.

examples.title: URL-synced group control (@bind-ExpandedKeys)
examples.code:
<TmAccordion ExpandedKeys="_expanded" ExpandedKeysChanged="OnExpandedChanged">
    <TmAccordionItem Key="install" Title="Install">...</TmAccordionItem>
    <TmAccordionItem Key="dark-mode" Title="Dark mode">...</TmAccordionItem>
</TmAccordion>

@code {
    private IReadOnlyCollection<string> _expanded = Array.Empty<string>();

    private void OnExpandedChanged(IReadOnlyCollection<string> keys)
    {
        _expanded = keys;
        // e.g. sync the URL: Nav.NavigateTo(Nav.GetUriWithQueryParameter("expanded",
        //     keys.Count == 0 ? null : string.Join(',', keys)), replace: true);
    }
}
